sentence: I will divide you into four small teams for the game.
synonym: split you into four small groups
synonymNote: split into groups与divide into teams意思相同，都表示分组

distractors.word: join you into four small teams
distractors.note: join表示加入合并，与divide分开的意思相反

distractors.word: mix you into four small teams
distractors.note: mix表示混合，不表示分成独立小组

distractors.word: choose you into four small teams
distractors.note: choose表示挑选，不表示将人分成小组
